title: hotfix: tighten slo-enforcer backoff and stabilize regional failover to avoid cascading load-shedding
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: During a recent regional outage we observed the SLO enforcer aggressively tripping circuit-breakers and applying exponential backoff in a way that caused cascading load-shedding across regions. This hotfix adjusts thresholds and adds a short stabilization window during regional failover to prevent oscillation. What changed: 1) Reduce sensitivity of error-rate based breaker by increasing minimum sample size and adding a 30s stabilization grace period when a regional failover is detected. 2) Change backoff behavior from full exponential to capped jittered backoff for the first three retries to avoid sharp throughput drops. 3) Add metrics and debug logging for enforcer decisions (feature-flagged). 4) Add unit and integration tests that simulate partial regional connectivity and validate no thrashing for 2x baseline request rates. Related: Linear ENG-2478 ENG-2599. This is a hotfix intended to be safe for immediate rollout. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Feature flag gating - [x] Manual canary in us-west1 - [x] Post-merge monitoring runbook

Maya Chen: We rely on existing health signals from routing; added an assertion and note in the runbook and informed routing SREs.
